expected: run one final reviewer_standard on the settled diff

expected: Closure verifies only the affected high-risk contract

verify every cited failure path and affected validation
keep each finding recorded until verified
forbidden: drop findings because the normal repair wave already ran
launch another Closure for the ordinary correction
